setup.title: Set up OpsNap
setup.subtitle: Create the only administrator account. This page disappears once you finish.
setup.setupCodeHint: Find “OpsNap 设置码” in the service startup log. For Docker, run docker logs <container>.
setup.footnote: A setup code exists only until the administrator is created, and changes on every restart.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to the console with the administrator account
login.forgot: Forgot the password? Run opsnap admin reset-password on the server.

settings.subtitle: Administrator account, sign-in methods and API tokens
settings.accountHint: The only administrator account. Changing the password signs out other browsers; API tokens are not affected.
settings.changePasswordHint: Other signed-in browsers are signed out; this one stays signed in. API tokens are not affected.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other browsers have been signed out

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.hint: For scripts and CI: send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Tokens can call every business API but cannot manage tokens or change the password.
tokens.createHint: The token can call every business API but cannot manage tokens or change the password.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: Describe its purpose, e.g. ci-deploy. Active tokens must have unique names.
tokens.showOnce: This token is shown only once. If you lose it, revoke it and generate a new one.
tokens.revokeHint: Requests using “{{name}}” will fail immediately. This cannot be undone.

storage.subtitle: Where backups are stored. Each storage is an encrypted kopia repository whose key all its jobs share.
storage.emptyHint: Add a local directory or S3-compatible storage as a destination for backups.

form.hint: The connection is tested before saving. An empty location gets a new encrypted repository; an existing kopia repository must be unlocked.
form.name: Name
form.pathHint: Absolute path on the OpsNap host; a missing directory is created with mode 0700.
form.endpointHint: No https://; a port is allowed, e.g. minio.lan:9000
form.secretKeep: Saved (encrypted). Leave blank to keep it
form.useTLSHint: Off means plain HTTP; only for internal networks
form.skipVerifyHint: For self-signed certificates; weakens transport security
form.locationLocked: Used by {{items}}, location cannot be changed

probe.notEmpty: The location is not empty and is not a kopia repository. Choose an empty directory or an existing kopia repository.
probe.sameRepository: Connected. Saving checks that the current key still opens this repository.
probe.notRepository: The location is no longer a kopia repository and cannot be saved.
probe.empty: Connected. The location is empty; next, set its encryption key.
probe.emptyMove: Connected. The new location is empty; saving creates a repository there with the current key.
probe.repository: Connected. The location is already a kopia repository{{created}}; next, enter its key to unlock it.
probe.repositoryMove: Connected. The new location is already a kopia repository{{created}}; saving asks for its key.

key.setHint: This key belongs to storage "{{name}}" and is shared by all backup jobs that use it.
key.label: Key
key.warning: Save this key in a password manager or offline. OpsNap keeps an encrypted copy for scheduled jobs and restores, but if the server is lost, reinstalled or wiped, only your copy can decrypt the backups, and we cannot recover it for you.
key.confirmSaved: I have saved this key and understand that losing it makes the data unrecoverable

keyFile.title: OpsNap repository key (keep it offline)
keyFile.command: Connect to this repository with the kopia CLI (enter the key above when asked for the password):

unlock.title: Unlock existing repository
unlock.hint: {{location}} already holds a kopia repository. Its key is needed to keep using it.
unlock.hintCreated: {{location}} already holds a kopia repository (created {{time}}). Its key is needed to keep using it.
unlock.fileHint: A key file exported by OpsNap, or a text file that holds only the key
unlock.wrongKey: Wrong key: it cannot open this repository. Failed attempts in a row: {{count}}.
unlock.notice: If this repository is not yours or its key is lost, create a new repository in an empty location instead. Existing snapshots are not deleted, but they can no longer be read.

move.title: Change storage location?
move.keepOld: The repository at {{from}} is left untouched, but this storage will no longer see its snapshots.
move.empty: New location empty: a repository is created there with the current key.
move.repository: New location holds a kopia repository: enter that repository's key to unlock it; this storage then uses that key.
move.notEmpty: New location not empty and not a kopia repository: cannot be saved.

delete.title: Delete storage "{{name}}"?
delete.hint: Only this record and the key held by OpsNap are deleted. The backup data in the storage is kept.
delete.warning: After deletion OpsNap no longer holds its key. To add this location again you must provide the key to unlock it. Make sure you have saved the key offline.

reveal.title: View key of "{{name}}"
reveal.hint: Verify your identity again to view the repository key.
reveal.shownHint: This is the password of this storage's kopia repository. With it and the official kopia CLI you can open the repository outside OpsNap.
reveal.cli: Connect with the kopia CLI and enter the key above when prompted:
reveal.oidcHint: Password sign-in is off. Verify again with {{provider}} below and return within 5 minutes to view the key.

error.not_bound: This OIDC account is not bound to OpsNap
error.idp: OIDC sign-in was cancelled or failed: {{description}}
error.invalid: OIDC sign-in could not be verified. Try again
error.unreachable: Could not connect to the OIDC provider
error.already_bound: An OIDC identity is already bound. Unbind it first

oidc.title: Sign-in methods
oidc.hint: Bind one OIDC identity as a way for the administrator to sign in. If the IdP is down, run opsnap admin reset-password on the server to re-enable password sign-in.
oidc.configureHint: Saving connects to the issuer and reads its OIDC discovery document.
oidc.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current secret
oidc.redirectHint: Register this as an allowed redirect URI in the IdP.
oidc.required: Display name, issuer, client ID and client secret are required
oidc.resetHint: After changing the issuer or client ID, the bound identity belongs to the old provider and is removed; bind again afterwards.
oidc.boundNotice: OIDC identity bound. You can now use it on the sign-in page.
oidc.unbindHint: You will no longer be able to sign in with it. You can bind again later.
oidc.passwordLoginOn: On · turn off to allow OIDC only
oidc.passwordLoginLocked: On · bind an OIDC identity and sign in with it once before turning this off
oidc.disableHint: You will only be able to sign in with OIDC. If the IdP is down, run opsnap admin reset-password on the server to turn it back on.
oidc.reenableNotice: Password sign-in will be turned back on.

sources.subtitle: Databases and servers to back up. Connections can go through network channels (SSH jump hosts, SOCKS5 proxies); saving triggers automatic capability probing.

channel.emptyHint: Create an SSH jump host or SOCKS5 proxy for data sources to connect through.

form.hint: A channel is one hop to a target; it can go through another channel to form a mixed SOCKS5 and SSH chain.
form.name: Name
form.privateKeyHint: Supports OpenSSH / PEM RSA, ECDSA and Ed25519 private keys; paste or upload a file.
form.passphraseHint: Required when the private key is encrypted
form.secretKeep: Saved (encrypted); leave blank to keep it
form.socks5CredentialHint: Username and password are optional, but fill in both or neither.
form.chain: Chain: {{chain}}. Channels that would form a cycle can't be selected; the chain has at most 5 hops.
form.chainTooLong: The chain has {{count}} hops, over the limit of {{max}}; it can't be saved.
form.hostKeyChangedHint: This host presented a key that no longer matches the saved one. Reconfirm it first.

result.testSuccess: Connected successfully; the chain has been confirmed.

delete.title: Delete channel "{{name}}"?
delete.hint: Only the record and credentials in OpsNap are deleted.

confirm.title: Confirm Host Key
confirm.hint: Connecting to {{address}} for the first time. Check the fingerprint below with your server administrator; confirming continues the connection and saves this key.
confirm.verifyHint: Run ssh-keygen -lf <public key file> on the server to see this fingerprint.

changed.title: Host Key Changed
changed.hint: {{name}} ({{address}}) presented a host key that doesn't match the saved one. Connections through it are rejected until confirmed.
changed.warning: A server reinstall or regenerated key can cause this, but it can also be a man-in-the-middle attack. Only trust it after checking the new fingerprint with your server administrator.

dataSource.emptyHint: Create a MySQL, PostgreSQL or server file data source.

list.name: Name
list.reconfirmChannelStale: Couldn't get the key channel {{name}} is currently presenting; try again shortly.

form.hint: Saving tests the connection over the network channel first; saving triggers automatic capability probing.
form.name: Name
form.privateKeyHint: Supports OpenSSH / PEM RSA, ECDSA and Ed25519 private keys; paste or upload a file.
form.passphraseHint: Required when the private key is encrypted
form.secretKeep: Saved (encrypted); leave blank to keep it
form.tlsCAHint: Paste PEM or upload a file; leave blank in the verify modes to use the controller's system trust store.
form.tlsClientCertHint: Optional mTLS; must be provided together with the client private key.
form.hostKeyChangedHint: This host presented a key that no longer matches the saved one. Reconfirm it first.

result.testSuccess: Connected successfully; probing will run automatically after saving.
result.testSuccessWith: Connected successfully: {{info}}. Probing will run automatically after saving.

delete.title: Delete data source "{{name}}"?
delete.hint: Only the record and credentials in OpsNap are deleted; the database or server is not affected.

detail.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, or the link is incorrect.

list.subtitle: Back up data sources to storage on a schedule. Every run leaves a record, and a successful run produces a restorable snapshot.
list.emptyHint: Create a job to back up a data source to storage on a schedule.

actions.deleteBlocked: The job is running or queued. Cancel it before deleting

delete.title: Delete job "{{name}}"?
delete.hint: The job and its run history are deleted together and cannot be recovered.

subtitles.source: Choose the job type and data source
subtitles.content: What to back up and how
subtitles.schedule: When to run and how long to keep

cancel.title: Discard this new job?
cancel.hint: Nothing you entered will be saved.

type.title: Job type
type.backupHint: Take point-in-time snapshots into storage and restore any time
type.syncHint: Continuously copy data to another instance of the same kind, without history

source.title: Data source
source.emptyHint: Create a MySQL or PostgreSQL data source on the Sources page first.

content.instanceHint: Databases are listed again on every run, so new ones are included automatically (system databases excluded).
content.databasesHint: Only the checked databases are backed up; a run fails if one of them no longer exists.
content.databasesFailed: Could not read the database list: {{message}}
content.noDatabases: The data source has no databases to back up
content.fullHintMysql: A complete export each time; chunk deduplication keeps the size down
content.fullHintPg: pg_dump exports each database in full; chunk deduplication keeps the size down
content.incrementalMysqlHint: Periodic full backups with continuous binlog archiving, restorable to any point in time
content.incrementalPgHint: Covers the whole cluster with continuous WAL, restorable to any point in time
content.mysqlTool: mysqldump (official) · consistent snapshot export without locking InnoDB tables
content.pgTool: pg_dump (official) · one custom-format archive per database

options.globals: Roles, tablespaces and other global objects

content.excludeHintMysql: One per line as database.table; tables that do not exist are not an error.
content.excludeHintPg: One per line as database.schema.table; tables that do not exist are not an error.

destination.storageHint: Which storage the snapshots go to
destination.emptyHint: Create a local directory or S3-compatible storage on the Storage page first.
destination.lockedHint: The data source, storage and path prefix cannot change after the job is created
destination.locationPending: shown after you choose a storage
destination.encryptionHint: Encryption belongs to the storage and uses its repository key; it cannot be changed here.
destination.encryptionPending: Shown after you choose a storage
destination.compressionHint: zstd balances speed and size well

schedule.cronHint: Standard 5 fields: minute hour day month weekday
schedule.retentionDays: Keep every snapshot from the last N days
schedule.retentionWeeks: Older than that, keep the last one each week
schedule.retentionMonths: Keep the last one each month
schedule.maxSnapshots: Under this schedule, at most about {{count}} snapshots are kept
schedule.alwaysKeepLatest: The most recent successful snapshot of this job is always kept

confirm.name: Job name
confirm.retentionSummary: All in last {{days}} days · then 1/week for {{weeks}} weeks · 1/month for {{months}} months
confirm.runLater: Wait for the next scheduled run
confirm.sizeEstimate: First run is a full backup; the source data of the selected databases is about {{size}}
confirm.sizeNote: It is usually smaller after export and compression.

errors.sourceNotReady: The data source is not healthy ({{reason}}); fix it on the Sources page first
errors.toolUnavailable: The export tool on the controller is unavailable; apply the fix and probe again
errors.storageNotReady: The storage is not healthy; fix it on the Storage page first
errors.prefixInvalid: Path prefix must be 1–128 letters, digits or ._-/, must not start or end with /, and must not contain .. or //
errors.prefixConflict: Path prefix duplicates or nests with job "{{name}}" in the same storage
errors.retentionDaysInvalid: Retention days must be an integer between 1 and 365
errors.retentionWeeksInvalid: Retention weeks must be an integer between 0 and 520
errors.retentionMonthsInvalid: Retention months must be an integer between 0 and 120
errors.retriesInvalid: Retries must be an integer between 0 and 5
errors.retryIntervalInvalid: Retry interval must be between 1 and 120 minutes
errors.timeoutInvalid: Timeout must be between 10 and 2880 minutes (10 minutes to 48 hours)
